overview: The commission addressed multiple abatement requests, approved a second water meter for the Riverside Yacht Club, and discussed meter installation progress and municipal water billing practices.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the previous meeting.

items.title: Petition 1742: Water Abatement Request
items.summary: Tabled an abatement request on an approximately $16,000 bill resulting from frozen pipes pending an insurance determination, while voting to waive interest until the matter is resolved.

items.title: Medford Housing Authority Interest Abatement
items.summary: Approved waiving accrued interest on Medford Housing Authority accounts following a check processing issue, while keeping the underlying balance due.

items.title: Riverside Yacht Club Second Meter Request
items.summary: Approved a second water meter for the Riverside Yacht Club based on City Council support and the club providing free dock space to the Medford Fire Department.

items.title: Meter Replacement Progress and Municipal Billing Discussion
items.summary: Reviewed progress on the citywide water meter replacement rollout and discussed the impact of unbilled municipal water usage on the department budget and water conservation.
